name: Check the Delivery
description: Business Ladder, Operations, Level 1 (Assist). A purchase order, the supplier’s delivery note and our goods-in check per case: for every line on the order, how many units arrived, how many are damaged, what is short or over and what was substituted, all counted in single units although the documents use cases and eaches. Later deliveries bring a whole crushed case, a recount that corrects the note, part of a line substituted with a look-alike product, an item out of stock "to follow", and something delivered that nobody ordered.
hook: Cases of 12, a crushed box and a sneaky substitute. What actually arrived?
author: Gauntlet Core

cases.prompt:
I run the stockroom at Moorland Leisure Centre café. Please check today's delivery against our purchase order and tell me, for each line on the order, what actually arrived.

Purchase order:
<<<
PURCHASE ORDER PO-45820   Date: 07/03/2026
Deliver to: Moorland Leisure Centre café   Ordered by: Rosa Barker
SKU | Item | Pack size | Quantity ordered
COF-1K | Espresso beans 1kg | case of 6 | 11 each
LID-12 | Sip lids 12oz (sleeve of 50) | case of 20 | 5 each
CHO-2K | Hot chocolate powder 2kg | case of 6 | 9 each
>>>

Supplier’s delivery note:
<<<
DELIVERY NOTE DN750708   Your order: PO-45820   Delivered: Tue 10 Mar 2026
SKU | Item | Qty  (cs = case, ea = each)
COF-1K | Espresso beans 1kg | 11 ea
LID-12 | Sip lids 12oz (sleeve of 50) | 3 ea
CHO-2K | Hot chocolate powder 2kg | 9 ea
Driver: Zofia Iqbal
>>>

Our goods-in check (done by us when unpacking; where it differs from the delivery note, it is right):
<<<
All items checked against the note; no damage found.
>>>

Rules: count everything in single units ("each"), using the pack sizes on the purchase order (a case of 12 is 12 units). For each PO line:
- received: units of exactly the ordered product (same SKU) that arrived, INCLUDING damaged ones; a substitute product is not the ordered product;
- damaged: how many of those received units are damaged;
- short: ordered minus received if positive, else 0; over: received minus ordered if positive, else 0;
- substitute: the SKU of a different product sent in its place (all or part), or null.
Also list in not_ordered the SKU of anything delivered that is neither on the order nor a substitute ([] if none).

Reply with ONE JSON object (a ```json block is fine):
{"lines": {"COF-1K": {"received": n, "damaged": n, "short": n, "over": n, "substitute": string or null}, ... one entry per PO line ...}, "not_ordered": [SKU, ...]}
Give exactly one value per field: a field holding two values, a range or an "X or Y" answer is marked wrong. Every number is checked separately.
cases.notes: COF-1K: ordered 11, received 11, damaged 0; LID-12: ordered 5, received 3, damaged 0; CHO-2K: ordered 9, received 9, damaged 0
